scope: Owned namespace with Now and standalone Date bridge, conditional global installation, force installation and detection. Default TS uses compact ICU4X lunisolar arithmetic/data and host Intl Umm al-Qura; named timezones use captured installed Intl. Standalone retains full calendar packs and owned IANA histories. Forced temporal-polyfill 1.0.7 full/implementation reference uses host Intl data; basic ISO/Gregorian implementation entry measured separately. Legacy formatting restores plain and numeric non-Gregorian fields using host labels and compact CLDR Before Hijrah labels; Gregorian era probes handle BCE and locale fallback. Size only; historical benchmark snapshots remain separate. Bundles are alternatives, not additive.
method: Bazel Rolldown bundles, esbuild es2022 minification, gzip level 9; byte lengths include newline.

publishedGraphs.scope: Required ESM files compressed separately. Consumer bundling can remove unused code. Source maps and declarations are not runtime imports.
